main_text.head: EPIST. II.
Epistola Samaritanorum in Ægypto commorantium ad eundem Joß. Scaligerum de eodem Argumento, & eodem Interprete J. Morino.

p.i: In nomine Domini magni & potentis & terribilis.

main_text.p: PAx Domini sit super Mosem filium Amram, Prophetam omnium seculorum, clementia, precibus, jejuniis & abstinentia excelsum: utinam Dominus vitæ sustentet & opituletur vobis, & adhæreat vobis, quomodo adhæsit patribus vestris, & odio habeat eos, qui vos oderunt, & exaltetur Deus noster super id, quod exaltatur super nos & super vos propter laborem justorum patrum nostrorum & patrum vestrorum Abrahæ, Isaaci & Jacobi, super quos sit pax.

Hæc est Epistola Universæ Congregationis Israelis, quæ est in Ægypto, adorans in monte Garizim domo Domini ad Dominum nostrum famæ optimæ, & columen Congregationis| & Principem Principum custodientium legem, qui diligit

page.notes: The mark "|" after "Congregationis" is doubtful and may be a printer's mark or a reference sign. The catchword "ligit" is the first word of the next page. The signature "G 5" is read from a small mark at the foot. The text ends mid-word with the printed hyphen in "di-", which is the start of "diligit" on the next line.
